institutionName: National and Kapodistrian University of Athens

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I wanted to live in a more tropical climate and live in the south of Europe.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was easy since i just went to the Erasmus Office and the University and there was a coordinator who was able to help us.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Erasmus coordinator helped a bit with classes and stuff since some of the ects points were different this semester than expected.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: The intro days got cancelled because of a strike, so we did not really have intro days except for a Buddy event. But it was okay.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I went into a Facebook group and found accomodation by putting up a post in the group. Many people offered rooms/studios but of course be carefull.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: I really liked it but of course you should know, that you might not love close to other students.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: To be honest I did not feel like the student housing offered looked cozy. Also the location was mostly not in the centre. That’s why I choose to find my own but I could have stated in the student offers since it was cheaper and probably with other students.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was quite fine with help from the Erasmus coordinator we just had to fill out a blanquet.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I just went to erasmus office and got the classes i put in my learning agreement. Then we got an email with a document we neeeed to fill out in order to confirm that we wanted to pre picked classes or change.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: My Erasmus coordinator was helpfull.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes i wanted, so very succesful I would say.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I would recommend contacting the uni and ask the coordinator or contact person about help.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I dont think the classes and teaching were at the same level as Denmark, but at the same time for me exhange was more about meeting people and new cultures, so it fit perfectly for this.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Level was low/mid, more expectations to the students at home. As an Exchange student from the north it will probably be easier.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The styke of teaching was Only lectures, where students were not expected to participate with cases or other stuff.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: I took Competition law, investment law, criminal procedure, civil procedure and intellectual property law.

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Investment law and intellectual property law, since i feel like they would be good to know off and usefull in Denmark as well.

Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: I did not really have any unexpected cost since everything worked out.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Public transport and food/eating out was so cheap compared to Denmark. More expensive probably is probably the clubs and bars.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The atlethic department was closed the whole semester, but Erasmus did a lot of social activities next to the School offers.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: We were only offered Erasmus activities.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend the green dinner/dance since it was a great introduction to all the Exchange students. Also the Buddy night was good too.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Go to the beaches, visit the nearby islands and see the inland nature, the mountains and small villages were amazing too.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: I feel like it was easy since the Athens was kind of international and very welcoming in generel. I did not feel unsafe.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: None unfortunately, i was only with erasmus mostly.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Not really any, except for their english sometimes were a struggle to understand.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The "going out" culture, they are always out and about at restaurants and bars. And I really liked that.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Please enjoy the weather, see all the turisty stuff since its free when you are from EU and under 25. Enjoy the restaurants!

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Buy the metro card so you can travel all over Athens very cheap as a student.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meeting so many amazing people from different cultures, really inspiring. I feel like you learn a lot about different cultures.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: A Challenge could sometimew be communicating with the locals.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: I don’t have any comment except i recommend everyone going!

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
